# Azrim Studio

> Creative marketing and design studio in Budapest, Hungary. Brand identity and logo design, social media management and content design, and website design for small and growing businesses (cafés, restaurants, clinics, shops, schools, service companies). Founded by Alireza Mirzahosseini (18+ years, 250+ projects, 8 countries). Works in English and Hungarian, plus Persian and Arabic.

## Services
- [Brand identity & logo design in Budapest](https://azrimstudio.com/branding-budapest/): strategy, logo family, colour and type system, guidelines, first applications.
- [Social media management in Budapest](https://azrimstudio.com/social-media-management-budapest/): content strategy, designed posts, Reels, stories, monthly review.
- [Website design in Budapest](https://azrimstudio.com/web-design-budapest/): mobile-first, multilingual sites with search basics.
